desc: Derive the bottleneck-path / MST reduction and the A-B matching characterization.
Implement DSU sweep over edges sorted by weight: component balance = (#A occurrences) - (#B occurrences); on union of opposite-sign balances add w * min(abs(bal_u), abs(bal_v)); merge balances.
Handle equal edge weights correctly, multiplicities, 1-indexing, 64-bit sums, and an efficient iterative DSU with path compression and union by size.
Validate against both provided samples and reason about equal-weight invariance and edge cases.
Add fast input parsing and print the final accumulated answer to stdout.
